description.value: Oretachi Curry is a casual Japanese curry restaurant in the historic Steveston village of Richmond, serving authentic Osaka-style curry rice and a distinctive curry ramen in a house-made prawn miso broth, built from a blend of over 20 spices with locally sourced BC ingredients. The original Oretachi Curry shop was founded in 2012 in Namba, Osaka, Japan by Mr. Sugimura, and the Steveston outpost brings that tradition to one of BC's most popular cycling destinations. Online ordering and takeout service make it a convenient mid-ride refuel stop along the Steveston waterfront.
